human description: Wishes his head were a little slimmer.
zombie description: His favorite food is brains of fish smaller than him.

human description: People think his body got eaten, but he was born like this.
zombie description: Where the brains go after he eats them is a mystery.

human description: The weight of his head often tips him sideways.
zombie description: Came up with a lamp that lights up when he spots a tasty brain.

human description: Generously wears a tin robot worth a small fortune on his head.
zombie description: Raids enemies carefully so he doesn't break his head parts.

human description: Realized his stiff shoulders come from his heavy head.
zombie description: Feels a little faster after winding his key.

human description: Has never lost a headbutt.
zombie description: Eating brains keeps his screws nice and tight.

human description: Former cafe worker. On the Block 1 footbridge...
zombie description: Slips through anything, so brain hunting is easy.

human description: Former salaryman. At the Block 2 intersection...
zombie description: A working man, so ghost or zombie, the tie stays on.

human description: Former musician. At the Block 3 crosswalk...
zombie description: A master of spooky "woooOOOooo" rhythms.

human description: Caught a cold from a chilly scalp, and then...
zombie description: Thanks to his halo, at least his head survived.

human description: Ace of the Diamond clan. Proudly guards the castle.
zombie description: Forget guarding the castle, he wants brains.

human description: Headbutting's stronger, but he uses a spear so he won't break it.
zombie description: His club hat can hold 3 brains.

human description: A kind soldier who takes his family to cafes on his days off.
zombie description: Usually gentle, but his eyes change when he spots a fresh brain.

human description: His card body is super hard, so his defense is great.
zombie description: Wonders if he can flip open his card to store brains.

human description: Wants to earn his mark and wear it on his head someday.
zombie description: I'm not bald... I was born like this, seriously, I'm NOT bald...

human description: Accidentally drops syringes into patients.
zombie description: Wants to be gentle, but keeps hunting for veins with the needle.

human description: Accidentally steps on important tubes and hurts patients.
zombie description: Always tries to smile, but always steps on important tubes.

human description: Accidentally slips handing over the scalpel and cuts patients.
zombie description: Tries not to repeat mistakes, but always drops the scalpel.

human description: Her specialty is ripping bandages with her teeth.
zombie description: The best time to bite is when patients look happy and healthy.

human description: Taking a cafe break before going to find Grandma.
zombie description: Wants to pack brains in her basket as a souvenir.

human description: Annoyed that everyone assumes riding hoods have to be red.
zombie description: Devours brains while the spatter dyes her hood red.

human description: Her hood was white, but she never washed it. Now look.
zombie description: Proudly wears her collection of wolf skulls.

human description: Wrapped in something that smells awful, and can't see a thing.
zombie description: Wants to slurp up that wolf's brains.

human description: Grew up a little, and her clothes got more grown-up.
zombie description: Can't forget the thrill of taking down the wolf.

human description: Won't answer unless you call him Red Dragon Knight.
zombie description: Attacks screaming "Red Terror! RED DRAGON KNIGHT!"

human description: Forces everyone to call him Green Dragon Knight.
zombie description: Attacks screaming "Green Lament! GREEN DRAGON KNIGHT!"

human description: Being called Blue Dragon Knight makes his whole day.
zombie description: Attacks screaming "Blue Lightning! BLUE DRAGON KNIGHT!"

human description: Wishes people would call him a Dragon Knight.
zombie description: Attacks screaming "I am the legendary DRAGON KNIGHT!"

human description: Charges bravely at the enemy. At home, too.
zombie description: Enemies at home: eliminated.

human description: Defends the rear flawlessly. At home, too.
zombie description: The household budget is perfectly defended.

human description: Ambushes the enemy guerrilla-style. At home, too.
zombie description: Utterly defeated by her mother-in-law's surprise weekend visit.

human description: Specializes in covert ops. At home, too.
zombie description: Uses covert ops to hide her secret savings.

human description: Even with a mechanical body, getting shot hurts.
zombie description: Was worrying about a life as a machine... then became a zombie.

human description: In a pinch, he fires eye beams to corner criminals.
zombie description: Figures it's fine to eat the brains of criminals he arrests.

human description: Attends meetings day and night to keep his district safe.
zombie description: Dozes off in meetings, but he's a machine, so nobody can tell.

human description: Kids point at him when he stands outside the police box.
zombie description: Worried he's rusting while standing outside the police box.

human description: When will the Captain quit? is her catchphrase.
zombie description: Her hobby is slowly rusting the Captain's weapons.

human description: Doesn't the Captain kinda smell? is her catchphrase.
zombie description: Her hobby is putting mop water in the Captain's tea.

human description: Spreads rumors that the Captain's weapons feel slimy.
zombie description: Her hobby is slowly thinning the Captain's armor.

human description: Desperate not to be hated by the knights' girl clique.
zombie description: At the bottom of the knights' girl clique.

human description: When she smiles her goddess smile, everyone freezes.
zombie description: Believes a goddess's job is smiling, so she barely works.

human description: Her devoted nature ruins her love life.
zombie description: Slurps discarded brains, vowing to be more devoted to the next guy.

human description: Pure compassion, but can't get a boyfriend.
zombie description: Figures anyone whose brain she's eaten counts as a boyfriend.

human description: Doesn't know who her destined lover is.
zombie description: Wanders day and night seeking her true love and tasty brains.

human description: Complains to his retainer once a day about his heavy helmet.
zombie description: When he's grumpy, he kicks his retainer's shins until he cries.

human description: Beams shoot out when he takes off his eyepatch.
zombie description: When alone, he plays with eyepatches over both eyes.

human description: His wild-haired helmet keeps his head warm.
zombie description: Being a zombie made his helmet start shedding.

human description: The battlefield is scary, so he ran off for a cafe break.
zombie description: If it's for brains, he feels he could shine on the battlefield.

human description: Sips tea at the cafe, deciding who should commit seppuku.
zombie description: Would rather order heads cut off than bellies.

human description: Afternoon practice is a pain, so he'll make someone commit seppuku.
zombie description: Wants to master the Way of the Zombie over the Way of the Samurai.

human description: Orders cowards to commit seppuku for lacking resolve.
zombie description: Not wanting brains means you lack zombie resolve.

human description: Trains hard so he won't be ordered to commit seppuku.
zombie description: Wonders if eating his captain's brain would get him off the hook.

human description: Falls off her broom and gets hurt 4 times a month.
zombie description: Thanks to being a zombie, falling off her broom doesn't hurt.

human description: Mostly simmers curry in her big cauldron.
zombie description: Sometimes simmers brain stew in her big cauldron.

human description: Magic is tiring, so she hasn't used it in over 100 years.
zombie description: For brains, she might try magic for the first time in a century.

human description: Can't use magic yet, but calls herself a witch.
zombie description: Became a zombie before becoming a full-fledged witch.

human description: Platform guide for the rapid train.
zombie description: Body-slams any groper he spots on the train.

human description: Platform guide for the express train.
zombie description: Body-slams any suspicious package he spots on the train.

human description: Platform guide for the limited express.
zombie description: Body-slams any fight he spots on the train.

human description: Platform guide for the local train.
zombie description: In charge of pressing the emergency button for sick passengers.

human description: Wandered not into Wonderland, but a Wondercafe.
zombie description: As a zombie, the cafe tea tastes better.

human description: Lives to boss around her card soldiers.
zombie description: Hangs any card soldier who says Alice is cuter.

human description: Makes a fortune working nonstop at a tsundere maid cafe.
zombie description: Became even more hyper-tsundere as a zombie.

human description: Anyway, she's good friends with Alice.
zombie description: Plotting to eat Alice someday.

human description: Always takes the blame for her bratty sister. Chronically tired.
zombie description: Looks sluggish, but she's actually motivated.

human description: A super upbeat, funky construction dude.
zombie description: So funky he'll crazily eat anything.

human description: A complaining office lady who grumbles every day.
zombie description: Got tired of complaining, so she decided to eat people.

human description: A secretary who loves panda and maid cosplay.
zombie description: Suddenly wondered why she was a secretary, so she got zombified.

human description: A pig-faced human who loves to eat.
zombie description: Ever since turning, he's always starving.

human description: A mischievous monkey-faced human who's great at sports.
zombie description: Stopped caring about working hard for anything.

human description: Looks tough, but a gentle kappa-man at heart.
zombie description: Hates cucumbers since becoming a zombie.

human description: A super calm, sometimes strict, actually bald monk.
zombie description: Got tired of bossing underlings, so he went solo.

human description: A bull-man whose only strong point is his horns.
zombie description: Got tired of grass and started eating meat too.

human description: Eldest of the four Ashura brothers. Hates complainers.
zombie description: Always targets the complainers.

human description: Second of the four Ashura brothers. A ladies' man.
zombie description: Still goes after the ladies, even as a zombie.

human description: Third of the four Ashura brothers. Thinks about nothing.
zombie description: Lost his brain, so now he thinks even less.

human description: Youngest of the Ashura brothers. Worries he alone has a robot face.
zombie description: Recently figured out why he alone has a robot face.

human description: A regular guy who's sort of a desert prince, in love with Jasmen.
zombie description: Forgot Jasmen existed after becoming a zombie.

human description: A desert princess head over heels for Aladdeen.
zombie description: Now head over heels for other zombies instead of Aladdeen.

human description: A shut-in living in a lamp.
zombie description: Forgot how to get back in the lamp after becoming a zombie.

human description: An IT otaku bored of desert life.
zombie description: IT... what's that!? Can't remember ever liking IT.

human description: A farm-raised Buff Pigeon. No nutrition, but a little happiness.
zombie description: A farm-raised Buff Pigeon. No nutrition, but a little happiness.

human description: A pen-raised Buff Pigeon. Fatty, not very nutritious.
zombie description: A pen-raised Buff Pigeon. Fatty, not very nutritious.

human description: A wild Buff Pigeon raised in nature. High protein, zero fat.
zombie description: A wild Buff Pigeon raised in nature. High protein, one fat.

human description: A rare, nutrient-packed Buff Pigeon. Eating it brings immense joy.
zombie description: A rare, nutrient-packed Buff Pigeon. Eating it brings immense joy.

human description: Came to the cafe looking for a partner.
zombie description: A dog would do at this point. It's just the back legs.

human description: Any crybabies around here!?
zombie description: Is there a crying child among our customers?

human description: Any bad kids around here!?
zombie description: So, like, I heard there's a bad kid in this cafe?

human description: The end result of fulfilling every customer's request.
zombie description: Get bitten all you like for $3,000. Guaranteed good health.

human description: Head of the Pirate family.
zombie description: Former harpoon fisherman. Retired when zombie life ruined his eyes.

human description: Ancestor of the Pirate family.
zombie description: Often pops up at the Pirate home in the middle of the night.

human description: The Pirate family's fearsome wife.
zombie description: Housewife and part-timer. About to be fired for eating a coworker.

human description: A salesman who loves pirate cosplay.
zombie description: Feels like a pirate as a zombie, but he's still a salesman.

human description: False lashes and red lipstick are part of his daily routine.
zombie description: Invisible or not, makeup is a must.

human description: A cowboy, even with glasses.
zombie description: So faint that without his hat, no one knows who he is.

human description: Solves riddles even when no one notices him.
zombie description: Invisible, but still solving riddles!

human description: His brain is so transparent he can't think, so no fashion sense.
zombie description: Never without beach sandals and gloves.

human description: This is NOT a wig! It's my real hair!
zombie description: Somehow his hair is starting to look like a scorpion.

human description: It's NOT bed head!
zombie description: Can't tell if he wants a mohawk or a pompadour.

human description: Her hair is so stiff it takes an hour to style.
zombie description: Maybe neon for the next hair color.

human description: Worked hard at finding a husband since her late 20s!
zombie description: Finally married in her late 30s, but ate the groom~

human description: Went to singles mixers every week~
zombie description: Married rich like she dreamed, but now it's zombie life.

human description: Finally married her longtime boyfriend.
zombie description: Tried to eat the groom and got punched.

human description: Got really depressed about a lung tumor, but couldn't quit smoking...
zombie description: After turning, the tumor got added to his brain.

human description: Tried wearing the lobster from the wedding banquet.
zombie description: The lobster got stuck on her head and she turned.

human description: A pro Maidroid who acts very maid-like!
zombie description: That is... something maid-like...

human description: Down with heroes! I'll be a villain forever!
zombie description: Starting to realize heroes can't be beaten... but I keep fighting.

human description: A lion dancer who danced flawlessly for 5 years and turned gold.
zombie description: Rust-proof gold, so you can lick it all you want. Lick lick.

human description: Formerly a blonde.
zombie description: Often mistaken for Anne of Green Gables.

human description: Used to be skin and bones.
zombie description: Got muscular.

human description: Surprisingly droopy-eyed.
zombie description: His head is stuffed with straw.

human description: Was stripped naked.
zombie description: Surprisingly toned.

human description: The emperor of Egyptian pro wrestling.
zombie description: I won't lose to any zombie!

human description: The most popular ace wrestler in Egypt.
zombie description: Holds the record for most no-contests.

human description: A diva who keeps supplying foreign objects.
zombie description: Supplying food is a first for her.

human description: A young Egyptian wrestler known for his speed.
zombie description: Can survive about a 30-meter fall.

human description: Came to Japan because she heard everyone wears yukata.
zombie description: Noticed her outfit was off at the airport and became a zombie.

human description: An ordinary yukata girl.
zombie description: An ordinary zombie with a morning glory on her head.

human description: Making her cafe debut in America's No.1 yukata.
zombie description: Japan's worst-dressed yukata girl.

human description: Trying hard to look young for Frankenstein.
zombie description: I-I look like Frankenstein's wife!? Oh well.

human description: Formerly a pink car.
zombie description: Isn't this hairdo totally rad?

human description: Formerly a compact car.
zombie description: Now that I'm a zombie, there's no going back.

human description: Formerly a car with a sunroof.
zombie description: The sunroof vanished when he became a zombie.

human description: Formerly a tin robot.
zombie description: After some body modding, now a steel robot.

human description: Why am I even a fairy?
zombie description: I really wanted to be human.

human description: I'm not wearing this headpiece because I want to.
zombie description: Something bit my head and now it won't come off.

human description: Been a fairy for a long, long time.
zombie description: Started as a fairy, ending as a fairy... huh.

human description: Actually the Japanese Yukata Girl's little sister.
zombie description: Even as a zombie, she's more popular than her sister.

human description: Being alone is so lonely...
zombie description: How long will I be a floating ghost? I want to go to heaven.

human description: A gorgeous hero, but she's bored of it.
zombie description: Stabbed herself to see if it hurt. No pain.

human description: What I'm holding is NOT a war fan.
zombie description: Been strangled by her own hair for a week. Hard to fight.

human description: With my magic, men fall for me in an instant.
zombie description: I've been possessed by an evil headpiece.

human description: Hanging out with a female hero kinda rubs off on you~
zombie description: Dressing as a woman might be nice...

human description: Floats like a succubus, stings like a bus.
zombie description: Floats like a bus, sucks like a succubus.

human description: Her karaoke high score is 72 points.
zombie description: The Siren who sings do-re-mi backwards.

human description: Nobody accepts her birdbrain, which doesn't match her face.
zombie description: Can't tell a birdcage from a jungle gym.

human description: 300 times the glycogen.
zombie description: Cries into his pillow saying "Cock-a-doodle-corn."

human description: Why am I the only one who has to wear an apron!?
zombie description: Ugh, whatever. So not motivated.

human description: I was born and raised in Japan, through and through.
zombie description: Found a rubber band, so she tied her side ponytail.

human description: Her frizzy hair is a pain.
zombie description: Seems a bubblegum bubble popped and stuck to her mouth.

human description: I used to wear my hair down a lot.
zombie description: Why am I the only one without a hair accessory!?

human description: Named the man who looks best with roses. Actually a woman.
zombie description: Stabbed the rose in so it won't leave her.

human description: Roses, roses, roses. I'm sick of them.
zombie description: I'll eat those stupid roses.

human description: If there's no bread, why not become a zombie?
zombie description: Marie is rotting and smelly, so she hides it with lots of roses.

human description: Anyway, a noble.
zombie description: Looks awful, but still a noble.

human description: Mascot of the Junkies.
zombie description: Doesn't mind hurting his neck with centrifugal force.

human description: Mascot of the Alpaca Standers.
zombie description: Specializes in getting hit by home run balls every time.

human description: Second-gen mascot of the Red Foxes.
zombie description: Shakes brains with a home run rap.

human description: First-gen mascot of the Red Foxes.
zombie description: At its peak, this mask got 120,000 orders a month.

human description: Let's go buy an ice cream sandwich! Yeah!
zombie description: Mmm~ ice cream sandwiches really are the best!
